author: Telos I
title: Telos I - Paper Gen. Test: ComBat + FWPCA
abstract: Generalization test for a future paper. This experiment applies FWPCA to a simple ComBat baseline (with 2000 HVGs) to test if the performance benefit of FWPCA is a general principle, as suggested by the reviewer of my rejected paper.
